about: Requests as people write them, with whether the strongest model should take them (hard). size.ts asks the helper model about each and says how often it agrees.

requests.text: What's the difference between a list and a tuple in Python?
Rename the function getUser to fetchUser everywhere in src/ and update the imports.
Write a cover letter for a data analyst job at a mid-size retailer. I have three years of SQL and Tableau.
Summarize the attached meeting notes in five bullet points and list the action items with owners.
Plan a four-day trip to Lisbon in May for two, with one day in Sintra and a budget of 1200 euros.
Add a --json flag to the export command so it prints one JSON object per row instead of the table.
The login button is misaligned on phones: it sits 8px too low next to the email field. Fix the CSS.
Translate README.md into Greek and Chinese, keeping the code blocks as they are.
Which of these three laptops is best for video editing under $1500? Compare them in a table.
Write unit tests for the parseDate function in utils/date.ts covering ISO dates, slashes and invalid input.
Make a weekly meal plan for a family of four, vegetarian, with a shopping list grouped by aisle.
URGENT!!! this is really important: please update the copyright year in the footer to 2026 on every page.
Read sales.csv and plot monthly revenue by region as a line chart, then tell me which region grew most.
Add pagination to the /api/orders endpoint: page and pageSize query parameters, 20 per page by default, and return the total count. The orders table has an index on created_at already.
The test test_user_signup fails with 'KeyError: email' since yesterday's commit that renamed the form field to email_address. Fix it.
Explain how transformers work to someone who knows linear algebra but no deep learning.
Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that runs npm test on every pull request and caches node_modules.
Convert these 40 Markdown files in docs/ to use sentence case in their headings.
Prove that for every n >= 1 the number of domino tilings of a 3 x 2n rectangle satisfies a(n) = 4a(n-1) - a(n-2), and derive a closed form.

Our payment service deadlocks about once a week under load. We've added logging twice and tried two fixes (lock ordering in OrderService, a timeout on the ledger lock); it still happens and nobody understands why. Here are the thread dumps from the last three incidents. Find the cause.

Design the storage engine for our time-series database: it must take 2M writes/s on one node, answer range queries over a year of data in under 100 ms, survive a crash without losing acknowledged writes, and compact without stalling writes. We keep going back and forth between an LSM tree and a columnar segment store; work out the trade-offs and give a design.

Our lock-free queue passes all tests but TSan occasionally reports a data race in dequeue on ARM only, and in production we see about one corrupted element per billion operations. Is the algorithm wrong under the C++ memory model, or is it our implementation? Give a proof either way.

The training loss of our 2B-parameter model diverges to NaN around step 41k, but only with mixed precision and only when gradient accumulation is 4 or more. We have ruled out the data, the learning-rate schedule and the optimizer epsilon. Find out why.

Is this key-exchange protocol secure against an active attacker who can replay messages across sessions? Either find an attack or give a reduction to the hardness of CDH. The protocol description is attached.

We need to migrate a 4 TB Postgres database with 600 tables to a new sharded layout with no downtime, while 30 services keep writing to it, some of them with cross-table transactions we cannot change this quarter. Work out a migration plan that cannot lose or duplicate a write, and say what could still go wrong.

Derive the asymptotic variance of this estimator under the misspecified model in section 3 of the attached draft, and check whether the sandwich estimator we use in the experiments is consistent for it.
Find why our compiler's register allocator produces wrong code for this 12-line function at -O2 only: the bug disappears when we add a print statement, and three people have looked at it for a week.

Come up with a new, provably correct algorithm for maintaining the strongly connected components of a graph under edge insertions and deletions in polylogarithmic amortized time, or explain precisely why known lower bounds rule it out.
Refactor the billing module into smaller files: split invoice.ts (900 lines) by responsibility, keep the public API and the tests passing.
Build a small web page that shows the weather for a city I type in, using the Open-Meteo API.
